name: deploy-watch
description: Watches AWS CodeBuild projects: a chip above the prompt with the last build, a warning when a push to the deploy branch started no build, and a pane with recent builds, their logs in the app's Terminal and a Start build button.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Comma-separated CodeBuild projects, each optionally with the branch that deploys it: my-app-staging=staging, my-app-prod=main.

awsProfile.title: AWS profile
awsProfile.description: Profile the aws CLI calls use. Empty uses the CLI's own default.

region.title: AWS region
region.description: Region of the projects. Empty uses the profile's region.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the builds are read while nothing is running; running builds are read every 15 s.

missingBuildMinutes.title: Missing build warning (minutes)
missingBuildMinutes.description: How long after a push to a project's branch with no new build before the chip warns.

productionPattern.title: Production project pattern
productionPattern.description: Regular expression that marks a project as production (case-insensitive) in the Start build confirmation.

awsPath.title: aws path
awsPath.description: Full path to the AWS CLI when it is not on the PATH Claude Code sees.
